title: Patient Payment Plan Term Extension by Frequency of Added Care
content:
**Rule.** When a **Patient Payment Plan** installment is recomputed after added balances, the extension of the schedule follows how often care has been added to the plan: 12 months when at least 3 add-on enrollment entries (balances enrolled on a date other than the plan's offered date) were posted within the twelve whole months before the handling date, and 6 months for exactly 2 such entries, each only on tiers whose own add-on term extension is shorter; otherwise it is the tier's add-on term extension.

**Counting entries.** Every add-on enrollment entry counts, so two accounts enrolled on the same date are two entries; balances enrolled on the plan's offered date are not add-on entries. A date counts while fewer than twelve whole months have passed since it, whole months being counted the calendar way (a month complete only once the later date's day number reaches the earlier date's day number; from the 31st, a month without that day is not yet complete at its last day).

| Tier | Tier add-on term extension (months) | 3 or more entries | Exactly 2 entries | 0 or 1 entry |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 0 | 12 | 6 | 0 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 0 | 12 | 6 | 0 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 6 | 12 | 6 | 6 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 6 | 12 | 6 | 6 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |

**Hypothetical window.** With a handling date of 10 September, an entry dated 10 September of the year before has had twelve whole months pass and no longer counts; an entry dated 11 September of the year before still counts.
